scientific_integrity: Proof uses a direct combinatorial bijection and a completely specified exact-integer 54-state transition-matrix identity, corroborated by independent finite direct enumeration. All computations reproducible from embedded standard-library scripts.
scientific_limitations: The theorem determines the exact reduced integral Euler characteristic for k=4 on 3-by-n rectangular grids, n>=2, but not the conjectured wedge-of-five-spheres homotopy type, separate Betti groups, or torsion. Equivalent unindexed literature is possible; independently unvalidated.
title: Euler characteristic of four-robust clique complexes of three-row grids
